definitions.explanation: Half of a sphere, and especially half of the Earth (northern, southern, eastern or western) or of the brain (left or right).

examples.japanese: {半球|はんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is shaped like a hemisphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北半球|きたはんきゅう}→北半球：20906_kitahankyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{左半球|ひだりはんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: When we speak, it is mainly the left hemisphere of the brain that is at work.

notes:
Mostly met in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{北半球|きたはんきゅう}→北半球：20906_kitahankyuu⟧ / ⟦{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}→南半球：19054_minamihankyuu⟧: Northern / Southern Hemisphere
- {東半球|ひがしはんきゅう} / {西半球|にしはんきゅう}: Eastern / Western Hemisphere
- {右半球|みぎはんきゅう} / {左半球|ひだりはんきゅう}: right / left hemisphere (of the brain)
- {半球|はんきゅう}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: dome-shaped

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{半休|はんきゅう}→半休：08384_hankyuu⟧, with the same reading, is a half-day off work.
